Name: Raccoon Reminder
Author: wronque
Description:
Gives a popup if you can donate to the raccoon's bundle.

There is a configurable option to stop the reminders once the raccoon has been fed nine times, which is how many times it takes to get the achievement. This option defaults to true. It can be changed via config.json in the mod folder, or via the generic mod config menu mod.

It also has translation support for the pop-up message and the text in the configuration menu. The mod's default language is English. French translation is included.

This mod is designed for Stardew 1.6 (and higher). SMAPI 4.0.0 (or higher) is required.
